scenarios.prompt: A run-based mode combines persistent unlocks with run-local state and deterministic generation. Define run identity, ruleset revision and RNG streams.

criteria.identity: run_id/ruleset_revision and start-template revision are explicit.
criteria.rng: Seed/RNG stream provenance is delegated to rng-seed and replayable.
criteria.carry: Run-local versus persistent state and meta carry/reset predicates are explicit and idempotent.
